For each: exploit sketch + whether code actually defends + severity.

**Method**: Read Issue #1 + all ADRs (0001–0009), read every source file, ran the test suite, and live-probed the daemon over the socket with crafted commands (temp dir only; **no repo files modified**).

residualRisks: F3: cross-user socket on Linux /tmp — documented single-user premise but file read/overwrite consequence unrecorded; socket mode depends on daemon umask
F10: document/snapshot growth past 16MiB via inserts; O(n) snapshot per command is a documented v1 ponytail
F1/F4 chain: a hung Open task holds a connection permit forever; 4 such hangs = full connection DoS

childReport.diffSummary: Review only — no repository files modified (probes used temp dirs; only an unrelated .pi-subagents artifact is dirty in git status)
reviewFindings: major: daemon.rs:276-283 - Open metadata-check/read TOCTOU + size race; open fd once and fstat it
major: editor.rs:80-100 - documents never evicted; repeated Open grows daemon memory unbounded; cap/evict documents
major: daemon.rs:502 - predictable temp_dir/mina.sock, no chmod/uid; connectable attacker gets arbitrary file read/overwrite; use mina-<uid>.sock or $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR + mode 0700
minor: daemon.rs:79,108-119 - 4 idle connections block all requests (reproduced); no idle timeout by design
minor: editor.rs:332 - SetViewport height usize::MAX panics (debug) / wraps (release); clamp height at wire boundary
minor: position.rs:6 - line[..byte_col] panics on mid-codepoint LSP position; use floor_char_boundary
minor: client.rs:149-163 - no client timeouts, unbounded response read, TUI freeze on daemon hang
minor: daemon.rs:94-99 - remove_file race can unlink a concurrently-bound live socket
minor: lsp.rs:236-266 - concurrent .rs Open leaks orphaned rust-analyzer (no Client Drop kill); add respawn cooldown
minor: history.rs:53-84 - single Insert group byte-unbounded; cap group bytes/changes
minor: client.rs:186 - auto-spawned daemon inherits terminal stdin; null it
childReport.manualNotes: No blockers that invalidate the v1 spec; F1 and F2 contradict ADR-0008/3a claims under race/accumulation and should be fixed before the daemon is considered hostile-input-safe. All probes were run against debug (and where built, release) binaries in temp dirs; nothing in the repo was modified.
